events.cos.ledger: { entry: SupervisorLedgerEntry } — every line the supervisor writes, as it is written
events.cos.system.state: { name, state, pid } — a system's state changed
events.cos.ui.navigate: { to } — a page asks the shell to open a route
events.cos.ui.notice: { level, text } — a page asks the shell to say something
events.cos.ui.tab: { tab } — the shell tells a cockpit which tab the address names
events.cos.update: { phase: started | refused | none | restarted | restart-failed | updated, mode, ... } — the update's steps, as they happen (CE2, 2026-11-02)
events.cos.notice: { notice, counts } | { read, counts } — the bell: a notice kept, or notices read (SC1, 2026-11-02)

pages.title: COS
pages.about: the frame: holds the one event stream and relays each event only to the pages that declare it

pages.title: Updates
pages.about: Nexus against GitHub, per system; Update now, Keep mine and update; the history and roll back; the gear holds the update settings (SC7, 2026-11-02)

pages.title: Emergence
pages.about: what emerges: Intelligence's crystallised patterns, the liminal spaces where they form, and his emergence runs (axioms → end state; innovate the method). One page with the TV's channel: the same script, served read-only from lib/ui/tv-shell/channels/emergence/.

planned.title: Compartment tabs
planned.does: Rewind, Versions, Diagnostics, Data, Resources, Settings, Macros and Tools for any compartment, not only Nexus's systems.

planned.title: Catalog
planned.does: Archetypes, schemas, blueprints and templates: read, edit against the schema, diff, fork, and make a compartment from one.

planned.title: Categories
planned.does: Categories as registry records, each with its archetype, schema, settings and members. Systems becomes one of them.

planned.title: Add
planned.does: Drop a zip or a .spec, deploy from a template, or connect to an address: COS says what it is and adds it, each step a gate.

planned.title: Timeline
planned.does: Every system state on one timeline: snapshot, branch, benchmark, merge after friction testing.

planned.title: Resources
planned.does: Caps, allocation and balance per compartment, virtual networks and storage locations.

planned.title: Builder
planned.does: Make templates and archetypes visually, every field from its schema.

planned.title: Pages on the registry bus
planned.does: Each page and section declared in COS's registry; the bus checks the registry instead of this contract. Waits on his acceptance of COS's registry.
